### We Build It Better

Since 1970, we have been fixing what fails in the auto industry. Our success is fueled by our
commitment to build better parts supported by better service.

[ [ACPN Award]][191]

### Content Excellence Award

CARDONE® Industries has been recognized as an award recipient at the 2023 Knowledge Exchange
Conference.

[Click to Read More][192]

[[CARDONE Reman Sustainability]][193]

### Reman = Sustainability

Since day one, we have operated from a position of environmental responsibility, where we live out
the 3 tenets of sustainability: Reduce, Reuse & Recycle.

[Learn About CARDONE Sustainability][194]

### OVER 50 YEARS OF EXPERIENCE AS AN INDUSTRY LEADER IN
### AFTERMARKET PARTS, ENGINEERING & INNOVATION

In 1970, Michael Cardone, Sr. and Michael Cardone, Jr. opened Cardone Industries in a North
Philadelphia storefront. The business started as a remanufacturer of windshield wiper motors - an
endeavor most in the automotive industry called an impossible idea. Through hard work and
innovation, the CARDONE company grew to be a leading supplier of high-quality, affordable
replacement parts.

[SEE OUR STORY][195]

[THE CARDONE STORY]

Since day one, we have operated from a position of environmental responsibility, where we live out
the 3 tenets of sustainability: Reduce, Reuse & Recycle.

[Learn About CARDONE Sustainability][194]

### OVER 50 YEARS OF EXPERIENCE AS AN INDUSTRY LEADER IN
### AFTERMARKET PARTS, ENGINEERING & INNOVATION

In 1970, Michael Cardone, Sr. and Michael Cardone, Jr. opened Cardone Industries in a North
Philadelphia storefront. The business started as a remanufacturer of windshield wiper motors - an
endeavor most in the automotive industry called an impossible idea. Through hard work and
innovation, the CARDONE company grew to be a leading supplier of high-quality, affordable
replacement parts.

# Home

## Welcome to Aisin USA

AISIN U.S.A. MFG., INC. is committed to and focused on creating high-quality components and systems
for some of the automotive industry’s most demanding companies.

Located in East Side Industrial Park in Seymour, IN, near Interstate 65, AISIN U.S.A. MFG., INC
(AUM) is committed to being the best employer in the communities in which we live and work.

### News from Around the World


With 200 locations and over 120,000 employees across the globe, AISIN is making headlines daily.

[Read More][18]

### Products


AISIN is committed to providing a wide range of products and systems covering nearly all the
components that comprise an automobile.

AISIN Corporation is consistently ranked among the worlds top Tier One automotive suppliers,
providing essential parts, components and technologies for most vehicles on the road today.

## Light and life
## to over a billion people

BHEL contributes more than 50% of the total power generated from conventional sources

As India’s foremost power equipment manufacturer, BHEL continues to play a pivotal role in
bolstering India’s energy security

## Harnessing the
## Power of Water

With dedicated design, engineering, erection & commissioning teams, BHEL is a one-stop solution for
Hydro Power Equipment

## Powering India
## Since 1964

With 200+ GW power generating capacity installed across the world, BHEL is the undisputed leader
amongst India's Power Plant manufacturers

## BHEL - Contributing to the
## Nation's self-reliance in the
## Aerospace sector

Chandrayaan 3 is equipped with BHEL manufactured Batteries for Lander Module & Propulsion Module &
Titanium Propellent Tank

## Fueling the Aspirations
## of Emerging India

Indigenously developed & supplied sucker rod pumps for oil & gas exploration

## Our Company

For 50 years, Cat Pumps has offered the most dependable positive displacement high-pressure triplex
pumps available. Designed and built to the highest quality standards, customers count on Cat Pumps
products to keep their equipment running. Every design detail of Cat Pumps products is optimized for
long-life and reliable performance, making Cat Pumps the most trusted name in high-pressure pumps
and systems.

[Read More][196]

## Quality Performance for Everyday Applications

Backed by the industry's best delivery, customer service, and technical support, Cat Pumps products
and service parts are readily available when you need them. A worldwide network of highly qualified
distributors provides sales and service support for pumps, parts and accessories when servicing is
required.

CNP integrates the advanced R&D technologies from Europe and America, with the most advanced
industrial design concept in Western Europe, with the production experience of modern industrial
clusters in North America, with the most efficient and energy-saving product structure research in
Hangzhou, China.

With the application of information technology, CNP has built its own smart factory, taking the lead
in the introduction of SAP resource management system, becoming one of the key units of the key
construction project of  "machine substitution" in Hangzhou, with the whole process of production
information monitoring and tracking, applying laser welding technology to the manufacturing process
of robot pump spare parts in depth, using progressive die technology to ensure the quality of the
whole process of the parts, all of which greatly reduce the production and manufacturing cycle,
provide an intelligent production and manufacturing basis for the pump production.

CNP was recognized as state-certified enterprise technology center in 2016. It is the highest
evaluation level for technology center in China. Besides, CNP has been carrying some technical
courses in 11/12/13th National Five-Year Plan.

CNP uses digital integrated intelligent control technology to create domestic advanced M2M mode,
intelligent control technology.

It includes intelligent current stabilization system, intelligent vacuum suppression system,
intelligent auxiliary control monitoring system, intelligent non-negative pressure full frequency
control system and intelligent water hammer two-way elimination system.

## Why Choose DENSO?

It’s simple. The DENSO brand is built on delivering more Quality, Reliability, and Value than any
other manufacturer. Whether supplying the world’s automakers with reliable OE parts or developing
aftermarket replacement parts at or above spec, DENSO’s line of products is built to deliver
superior all-around performance every day. Our First Time Fit® philosophy attracts attention
throughout the automotive world, while our commitment to pushing technology into the future
continually sets us apart around the globe. Read below for more ways DENSO rises above the rest.

## A Spark Plug for Everyone

Utilizing decades of experience developing the world’s leading spark plugs, the DENSO family of
spark plugs is unmatched in longevity, durability, increased power, economy and reliability.
* [Iridium TT®][81] – More power, economy, and endurance with the world’s smallest tip.
* [Platinum TT®][82] – Twin tip platinum design with superior longevity and durability.
* [Iridium Power®][83] – Maximum spark energy from the 0.4mm Iridium center electrode.
* [Iridium Racing®][84] – Reliable ignition even under the harshest racing conditions.
* [Iridium Long Life][85] – Improve longevity with the first automotive plug to use Iridium.
* [Double Platinum][86] – Two Platinum electrodes means added durability.
* [U-Groove][87] – A channeled ground electrode means greater fuel efficiency.

## Aftermarket Parts Built at or Above Spec

The quality of DENSO parts is guaranteed because every component that leaves a DENSO factory has
been designed with precision, manufactured to the strictest OE standards or above, and subjected to
rigorous safety and performance tests. In the end, it all comes down to quality — that’s what the
DENSO name stands for.

Through manufacturing, we have continued to think about the future of people, society, and the

#### Sustainability

Humanity is now facing major social issues such as global warming and resource depletion. Under the
slogan of "Supporting the world with technology," the EBARA Group is working to solve a wide range
of social issues and contribute to the sustainable development of the earth and society through the
technological capabilities and passion it has cultivated over the years, as well as various
solutions.

[View Sustainability][198]

#### Innovation Story

Ebara was founded in 1912 as a venture company originating from a university. Since that time, in
order to meet the needs of society and customers, we have boldly taken on challenges in the spirit
of "passion and sincerity" even in unknown areas. This spirit of innovation has been inherited to
the present day, and we continue to provide new value to the world by sincerely responding to the
diversifying needs of our customers, contributing to the resolution of social issues.

[See the innovation story][199]
[ [YouTube video:Generating a New Wave, Designing a New World] ][200]

## Generating a New Wave, Designing a New World

Generating a New Wave, Designing a New World

The EBARA Group has supported the ever-changing industry and social infrastructure, as well as the
evolving information society, with technologies that create the "flow" of water, air, electronics,
and energy. From now on, we will continue to create new "flows" that are needed in a changing world,
and create a better future full of rich smiles.

#### Sustainability

Humanity is now facing major social issues such as global warming and resource depletion. Under the
slogan of "Supporting the world with technology," the EBARA Group is working to solve a wide range
of social issues and contribute to the sustainable development of the earth and society through the
technological capabilities and passion it has cultivated over the years, as well as various
solutions.

[View Sustainability][198]

#### Innovation Story

Ebara was founded in 1912 as a venture company originating from a university. Since that time, in
order to meet the needs of society and customers, we have boldly taken on challenges in the spirit
of "passion and sincerity" even in unknown areas. This spirit of innovation has been inherited to
the present day, and we continue to provide new value to the world by sincerely responding to the
diversifying needs of our customers, contributing to the resolution of social issues.

[See the innovation story][199]
[ [YouTube video:Generating a New Wave, Designing a New World] ][200]

## Generating a New Wave, Designing a New World

Generating a New Wave, Designing a New World

The EBARA Group has supported the ever-changing industry and social infrastructure, as well as the
evolving information society, with technologies that create the "flow" of water, air, electronics,
and energy. From now on, we will continue to create new "flows" that are needed in a changing world,
and create a better future full of rich smiles.
